newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: George sees U.K. inflation at 2.5 pct this year.
newsitem.headline: George sees U.K. inflation at 2.5 pct this year.

text.p: BASLE, Switzerland, March 10 - Bank of England Governor Eddie George said he expected British inflation to reach the 2.5 percent target during 1997, but said the real question was whether it could be maintained at that level.
Asked whether British inflation would hit the 2.5 percent target, George said: "I should think so. We rather expect it in the course of this year."
"The question is not whether we will reach it, but maintain it," George told reporters at the Bank for International Settlements.
